pull: Clue: She was built in Britain
body:
Can you name this ship?

In the early hours of 21 November 1944, an American submarine in the Formosa Strait fired six torpedoes at this Japanese battleship. Two hit her port side and flooded two boiler rooms. A little over two hours later, as her crew abandoned ship, her forward magazine exploded and she sank with more than 1,200 men.

The clue is on the card. Drop your guess below.
photoNote: Kongō at speed on sea trials off Tateyama, 14 November 1936, after her second rebuild, as she looked at war. Imperial Japanese Navy official photograph (photographer unknown), public domain (Japanese photo published before 1957). No name or markings visible. Downloaded as the 1920 px Wikimedia thumbnail.
